ai_insight:
- **Disease Name:** Viral Infection (possible cause of headache and fever)
- **Medicine:** Paracetamol (500mg, every 4-6 hours as needed)
- **Diet:** Stay hydrated with plenty of fluids, eat light meals such as soups and crackers, avoid heavy or spicy foods
- **Safety Tip:** Monitor body temperature and seek medical attention if it exceeds 103°F (39.4°C)
- **Myths:** Myth: Antibiotics are effective against all infections. Reality: Antibiotics only work against bacterial infections, not viral ones.
- **Description:** A viral infection can cause a range of symptoms including headache and fever, and is typically self-limiting but may require medical evaluation to rule out more serious conditions.
- **Severity Score:** 4

Doctor consultation is recommended.
